title: 🔥周期回测至22年低点
body: 市场处于深度磨底阶段。AHR999为0.35，完全回归至2022-09熊市均值区间。然而MVRV录得1.22，仍高于上轮同期的0.92。数据对比显示，虽然价格触及抄底区，但链上整体并未出现上一轮那样的极端低估，市场筹码结构相对稳固。偏中性。这次底部是尖底还是圆底？
body_en: The market is deep in the bottom-grinding phase. AHR999 is at 0.35, fully returning to the mean range of the Sep '22 bear market. Yet, MVRV is recording 1.22, still higher than the 0.92 seen at the same point last cycle. The data shows that while price has touched the accumulation zone, on-chain metrics haven't reached the extreme undervaluation of the previous cycle; market structure remains relatively solid. Leaning neutral. Will this be a sharp V-bottom or a rounded bottom?
